**Chinese name:** 北京地平线机器人技术研发有限公司 (Běijīng Dìpíngxiàn Jīqìrén Jìshù Yánfā Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded July 2015; listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (9660.HK, entered the Hang Seng Tech Index March 2025 and the blue-chip Hang Seng Index itself at ~0.5% weight by the August 2026 review), one of the clearer success cases of a Chinese fabless firm reaching volume automotive design wins without an Entity List designation. Full-year 2025 revenue reached ¥3.758 billion (+57.7% YoY), while R&D spending grew even faster, up 63.3% to ¥5.154 billion — deliberately outspending revenue growth. H1 2026 (HKEX interim, 31 August) revenue was ¥2.055 billion (+32.9% YoY) with ¥1.356 billion gross profit (66% margin), licensing/services ¥1.129 billion (+52.7%) and chip shipments 2.218 million sets; the cumulative Journey milestone passed 15 million chips in September 2026, ~500 lifetime vehicle design wins, and city-NOA installed share rose to 22.8% (No. 2 behind Nvidia). VW/CARIAD converted early to become a ~9.9% strategic shareholder (closed 3 August 2026), with the Carizon joint venture's full-scenario AD (Journey 6 + HSD) entering mass production across seven new VW-group EV models; HSD V2.0's active-use ratio exceeds 88% of equipped vehicles, the cockpit-driving fusion '星空' SoC targets Q4 2026 production, and Journey 7 tape-out is expected around Q2 2027.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Automotive-grade processors and the accompanying software platform for intelligent/autonomous driving systems.
